notes.title: great patch
notes.content:
-new menu interface

-New Stage with BOSS 

-HP hearth spawn at 3500!

-2 new automatic weapons (they are pretty good)

-8 NEW CREATURES with better mechanics

-AZERTY keyboard suported

-One new beautiful song

-Wolves and foxes balanced

-bigger period of invulnerability (still short)

-stronger monsterS at 3500 points!

-a lot of small changes and improvements :)

hope you like it, and thanks a lot for all the suggestions, they help a lot :D

notes.title: Big Patch
notes.content:
-new Acid ammo indicator on cursor

-new Hp indicator on cursor

-Dash Cooldown indicator on cursor 

-Dash cooldown nerfed

-Shotgun, shark rifle and chainsaw rifle got a buff

-revolver got nerfed


Thanks for letting me know what to improve!

notes.title: fixed bugs and improvements
notes.content:
- new some ingame fast and visual tutorial

-fixed a bug with the acid puddles animation

-fixed sound group problems

-fixed snowman attack animation

-8500 to 5000 downgrade score needed to unlock new stages and weapons. Now its easyer, but the achievements still aim for 10.000 points (thay are pretty hard to get, but if i can do it you can do it better!)
